name: HeaderCell
intent: Column title for a data table: uppercase label, optional select-all checkbox, optional sort, with a brand-faint bottom border, 2px or 1px.
usage: Use HeaderCell inside th scope=col, one per column, above Cell rows. Match its size to the Cell size so side padding lines up. Use alignment end for number columns and center for a checkbox-only or actions column. HeaderCell composes kit Checkbox and Icon. See contracts/headercell.json for the full contract.

label.note: Column title, shown uppercase. Omit for a checkbox-only or empty column.

size.note: Height 40 / 48 px. Side padding 12 px at both sizes, same as Cell. Without a size it is md. A surrounding Density changes these sizes through the density tokens (Default values shown).

alignment.note: end for numbers and amounts. center for a checkbox-only or actions column.

line.note: The line under the title: medium is 2px, thin is 1px, both brand-faint. Table and DataGrid take line and pass it to every header, so the row keeps one line.

checkbox.note: Select-all Checkbox, labeled Select all {label} or Select all rows.

sortable.note: Makes the label a sort button. Needs a label.

sort.note: Current direction. The table cycles none, asc, desc on onSort.

useWhen: Column titles in a data table.
doNot: Do not invent a local th, TableHeader, ColumnTitle or SortButton.
Do not use Cell for column titles, or HeaderCell in body rows.
Do not mix HeaderCell and Cell sizes in one table.
Do not mix line weights in one header row. Set line on the Table or DataGrid.
Do not make a column sortable without a label.
a11y: Place it inside th scope=col. Set aria-sort on the th when a column is sorted.
The select-all checkbox has a hidden label: Select all {label} or Select all rows. Use indeterminate when some rows are selected.
The sort button is named {label}, sort ascending / descending / off, so it says what the next click does.
